name: Present simple
form: I/you/we/they work · he/she/it works · Do you work? · She doesn't work
use_en: Facts, habits, routines, timetables, and permanent states. Not for something happening right now.
use_hi: तथ्य, आदतें, रोज़ की दिनचर्या, समय-सारणी और स्थायी स्थितियाँ। जो अभी इसी समय हो रहा है उसके लिए नहीं।

examples.en: I work from home on Fridays.
examples.hi: मैं शुक्रवार को घर से काम करता हूँ।

examples.en: The scanner runs every night at 2 a.m.
examples.hi: स्कैनर हर रात 2 बजे चलता है।

examples.en: She doesn't like spicy food.
examples.hi: उसे तीखा खाना पसंद नहीं है।

hindi_trap: Hindi 'करता हूँ' covers both habit and right-now, so learners say 'I work now' for 'I am working now'. Also the third-person -s is dropped: 'he work' ✗ → 'he works'.

name: Present continuous
form: am/is/are + verb-ing · I'm working · Is she coming? · They aren't listening
use_en: Happening right now, temporary situations, changing trends, and fixed future arrangements. Not with state verbs (know, have, like, want).
use_hi: जो अभी हो रहा है, अस्थायी स्थितियाँ, बदलते रुझान और तय भविष्य की योजनाएँ। स्थिति-सूचक क्रियाओं (know, have, like, want) के साथ नहीं।

examples.en: I'm reviewing the logs right now.
examples.hi: मैं अभी लॉग देख रहा हूँ।

examples.en: More companies are moving to passkeys these days.
examples.hi: आजकल ज़्यादा कंपनियाँ पासकी की ओर जा रही हैं।

examples.en: We're meeting the client on Tuesday.
examples.hi: हम मंगलवार को क्लाइंट से मिल रहे हैं।

hindi_trap: The classic Indian error is continuous with state verbs: 'I am knowing', 'I am having a car', 'She is understanding' ✗. Use the simple form: I know, I have, she understands.

name: Present perfect
form: have/has + past participle · I've finished · Has he left? · We haven't decided
use_en: A past action with a present result, life experience with no time given, or something that started in the past and continues (with since/for). Never with a finished-time word like yesterday.
use_hi: ऐसा अतीत जिसका असर अब है, बिना समय बताए अनुभव, या जो अतीत में शुरू होकर अब तक जारी है (since/for के साथ)। 'yesterday' जैसे समाप्त समय के साथ कभी नहीं।

examples.en: I've already patched the server.
examples.hi: मैंने सर्वर को पहले ही पैच कर दिया है।

examples.en: Have you ever been to Singapore?
examples.hi: क्या तुम कभी सिंगापुर गए हो?

examples.en: She has worked here since 2021.
examples.hi: वह 2021 से यहाँ काम कर रही है।

hindi_trap: 'I have gone yesterday' ✗. If the sentence says WHEN, use past simple: 'I went yesterday'. Hindi 'गया हूँ' does not carry this restriction, which is why the error is so common.

name: Present perfect continuous
form: have/has been + verb-ing · I've been waiting · How long has it been running?
use_en: An activity that started in the past and is still going, or just stopped and explains a present result. Emphasises duration.
use_hi: ऐसी गतिविधि जो अतीत में शुरू हुई और अब भी चल रही है, या अभी-अभी रुकी है और वर्तमान परिणाम बताती है। अवधि पर ज़ोर।

examples.en: I've been working here for three years.
examples.hi: मैं यहाँ तीन साल से काम कर रहा हूँ।

examples.en: The build has been failing since the last merge.
examples.hi: पिछले मर्ज के बाद से बिल्ड फ़ेल हो रहा है।

examples.en: You look tired. Have you been sleeping badly?
examples.hi: तुम थके लग रहे हो। क्या तुम ठीक से नहीं सो रहे?

hindi_trap: 'I am working here since three years' ✗. Hindi uses the present continuous for this; English needs the perfect continuous and 'for' with a length of time: 'I have been working here for three years'.

name: Past simple
form: verb-ed / irregular · I finished · Did you see? · He didn't know
use_en: A completed action at a known or implied time in the past. The default tense for telling what happened.
use_hi: अतीत में एक ज्ञात या समझे गए समय पर पूरी हुई क्रिया। जो हुआ उसे बताने का मूल काल।

examples.en: We found the bug yesterday.
examples.hi: हमें कल बग मिला।

examples.en: Did you send the report?
examples.hi: क्या तुमने रिपोर्ट भेजी?

examples.en: I didn't know about the change.
examples.hi: मुझे बदलाव के बारे में पता नहीं था।

hindi_trap: After did/didn't the verb goes back to the base form: 'I didn't knew' ✗ → 'I didn't know'; 'Did you went?' ✗ → 'Did you go?'.

name: Past continuous
form: was/were + verb-ing · I was testing · Were they sleeping?
use_en: A longer past action in progress, often interrupted by a shorter past-simple action, or two actions happening at the same time.
use_hi: अतीत की लंबी चल रही क्रिया, जो अक्सर किसी छोटी past simple क्रिया से बाधित होती है, या एक साथ हो रही दो क्रियाएँ।

examples.en: I was reviewing the code when the alert fired.
examples.hi: जब अलर्ट आया, मैं कोड देख रहा था।

examples.en: They were still testing while we were deploying.
examples.hi: जब हम डिप्लॉय कर रहे थे, वे अभी भी टेस्ट कर रहे थे।

examples.en: It was raining all night.
examples.hi: पूरी रात बारिश हो रही थी।

hindi_trap: Learners overuse it for completed events: 'Yesterday I was going to the market and I was buying vegetables' ✗. Completed sequence = past simple: 'I went… and bought…'.

name: Past perfect
form: had + past participle · I had finished · Had she left?
use_en: The earlier of two past actions: what had already happened before another past moment. Common in reported speech and third conditionals.
use_hi: अतीत की दो घटनाओं में पहली वाली: दूसरे अतीत के क्षण से पहले जो हो चुका था। reported speech और third conditional में आम।

examples.en: By the time we noticed, the attacker had already left.
examples.hi: जब तक हमने ध्यान दिया, हमलावर पहले ही जा चुका था।

examples.en: She had never used Linux before that job.
examples.hi: उस नौकरी से पहले उसने कभी Linux इस्तेमाल नहीं किया था।

examples.en: I realised I had forgotten my badge.
examples.hi: मुझे एहसास हुआ कि मैं अपना बैज भूल गया था।

hindi_trap: Using it for any old event: 'I had visited Goa in 2015' ✗ (no second past action). One past event = past simple: 'I visited Goa in 2015'.

name: Past perfect continuous
form: had been + verb-ing · I had been waiting · How long had it been running?
use_en: Duration of an activity up to a point in the past, often explaining a past result.
use_hi: अतीत के किसी क्षण तक चली गतिविधि की अवधि, अक्सर अतीत के किसी परिणाम की व्याख्या।

examples.en: The service had been running for a week before anyone checked the logs.
examples.hi: किसी के लॉग देखने से पहले सर्विस एक हफ़्ते से चल रही थी।

examples.en: He was exhausted because he had been debugging all night.
examples.hi: वह थक गया था क्योंकि वह पूरी रात डिबग कर रहा था।

examples.en: We had been waiting for an hour when the train finally came.
examples.hi: जब ट्रेन आख़िरकार आई, हम एक घंटे से इंतज़ार कर रहे थे।

hindi_trap: Rare in speech; do not force it. Use it only when duration before a past moment matters.

name: Future with will / going to
form: will + verb · am/is/are going to + verb · I'll call you · We're going to migrate
use_en: will: decisions made now, promises, predictions from opinion. going to: plans already decided, predictions from evidence. Present continuous: fixed arrangements.
use_hi: will: अभी लिया गया निर्णय, वादे, राय पर आधारित अनुमान। going to: पहले से तय योजना, सबूत पर आधारित अनुमान। present continuous: पक्की व्यवस्था।

examples.en: I'll send the fix tonight.
examples.hi: मैं आज रात फ़िक्स भेज दूँगा।

examples.en: We're going to migrate to the new cluster next month.
examples.hi: हम अगले महीने नए क्लस्टर पर जाने वाले हैं।

examples.en: It's going to rain; look at the sky.
examples.hi: बारिश होने वाली है; आसमान देखो।

hindi_trap: After 'if' and 'when' English uses the present, not will: 'If it will rain' ✗ → 'If it rains'. And 'I will call you tomorrow' is fine, but a fixed plan sounds more natural as 'I'm calling you tomorrow'.

name: Future continuous
form: will be + verb-ing · I'll be working · Will you be using the room?
use_en: An action in progress at a future time, or a polite way to ask about plans.
use_hi: भविष्य के किसी समय चल रही क्रिया, या योजनाओं के बारे में विनम्रता से पूछने का तरीका।

examples.en: This time tomorrow I'll be flying to Delhi.
examples.hi: कल इसी समय मैं दिल्ली के लिए उड़ान भर रहा होऊँगा।

examples.en: Will you be using the test server tonight?
examples.hi: क्या तुम आज रात टेस्ट सर्वर इस्तेमाल कर रहे होगे?

examples.en: The team will be monitoring the rollout all evening.
examples.hi: टीम पूरी शाम रोलआउट की निगरानी कर रही होगी।

hindi_trap: Maps well to Hindi 'रहा होगा'; the trap is dropping 'be': 'I will working' ✗.

name: Future perfect
form: will have + past participle · I'll have finished · Will they have fixed it by then?
use_en: Something that will be complete before a future point. Almost always with 'by'.
use_hi: जो भविष्य के किसी बिंदु से पहले पूरा हो चुका होगा। लगभग हमेशा 'by' के साथ।

examples.en: By Friday we'll have closed all critical findings.
examples.hi: शुक्रवार तक हम सभी critical findings बंद कर चुके होंगे।

examples.en: She'll have left by the time you arrive.
examples.hi: तुम्हारे पहुँचने तक वह जा चुकी होगी।

examples.en: In June I'll have worked here for five years.
examples.hi: जून में मुझे यहाँ काम करते हुए पाँच साल हो जाएँगे।

hindi_trap: Learners avoid it and say 'By Friday we will close' — correct but weaker. Use it when the deadline is the point.

name: Future perfect continuous
form: will have been + verb-ing · I'll have been working here for ten years
use_en: Duration of an activity up to a future point. Rare; mostly with 'for' and 'by'.
use_hi: भविष्य के किसी बिंदु तक चली गतिविधि की अवधि। दुर्लभ; ज़्यादातर 'for' और 'by' के साथ।

examples.en: By December I'll have been learning English for a year.
examples.hi: दिसंबर तक मुझे अंग्रेज़ी सीखते हुए एक साल हो जाएगा।

examples.en: Next month they'll have been living in Pune for a decade.
examples.hi: अगले महीने उन्हें पुणे में रहते हुए दस साल हो जाएँगे।

examples.en: The scan will have been running for six hours by the time it finishes.
examples.hi: जब तक स्कैन खत्म होगा, वह छह घंटे से चल रहा होगा।

hindi_trap: Know it, recognise it, but do not reach for it in everyday speech.
